evidence.observation: O2 rose from ~4 ppm baseline to 11.6 ppm at start of growth
Monotonic O2 climb 11.6→18.8→23.3→32.4 ppm during growth at steady T, Ar, P
Ar flow stable at ~100 sccm, so rise is not a purge-gas change
Pressure steady ~760 Torr, T at setpoint, heater power nominal

args.missing_evidence: Response of O2 to an Ar flow step (leak would dilute/persist vs. outgassing), plus pressure/leak-up test or seal temperature check to confirm air ingress.
